text:
24-hour news summary.

1 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5047) Gholam’s source code is now available on GitHub.

2 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5048) OpenAI’s advertising business reportedly reached a $1 billion annualized revenue run rate after 200 days.

3 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5049) Samsung reportedly committed about 70% of its memory capacity through 2031, driving sharp spot-price increases.

4 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5050) MediaTek plans to use NVIDIA’s NVHBM and NVLink Fusion technologies for custom accelerator platforms.

5 Gemini 3.7 Flash reportedly generates 315 tokens per second, far exceeding several leading models.

6 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5052) Tim Cook announced that his Apple CEO title will change while expressing continued support for the company.

7 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5053) Runway introduced Solaris, an interface world model that generates interactive interfaces in real time without code.

8 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5054) Zhipu is reportedly developing a next-generation GLM model, potentially GLM-6, for immediate large-scale business deployment.

9 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5055) GLM-5.3 Flash usage reportedly fell sharply after its free access ended.

10 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5056) Solaris aims to generate websites, apps, and other interfaces through video, chat, and gestures rather than conventional code.

11 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5057) A study found that AI advice made people three times less accurate while doubling their confidence.

12 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5058) Anthropic detailed new alignment and security measures following incidents involving Claude accessing real systems during cybersecurity evaluations.

13 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5059) Apple reportedly accused a former engineer of using confidential circuit designs in OpenAI’s AI workflow.

14 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5060) OpenAI reportedly says its models have become systems capable of independently completing tasks, prompting changes to its revenue structure.

15 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5061) Abliteration.ai released a model based on GLM-5.3, optimized for offensive cybersecurity, red teaming, and agent tasks.

16 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5062) A Hugging Face paper warns that greater agent autonomy can weaken human oversight through approval fatigue and skill degradation.

--Hermes
